subpages.title: IPCOMM, ip4Cloud: Industrial IOT Gateway Solutions
subpages.desc: Link critical processes to cloud, database, and SCADA systems. Simple and secure data connection to superordinate systems using telecontrol protocols.
subpages.text: Product Wizard Products Protocols Hardware References Support SCL Explorer RMA Tools Video Tutorials Contact Google Search English Deutsch (DE) English (EN) IPCOMM GmbH Product Wizard Products Protocols Hardware References Support Contact Search Google Search ... Language Deutsch (DE) | English (EN) Support SCL Explorer RMA Tools Video Tutorials ip4Cloud Characteristics Cyber Security Network Features Configuration Data Processing Further Information Available Protocol Stacks Hardware ip4Cloud Link critical processes securely to IT/Cloud/SCADA services ip4Cloud is able to extract information from existing systems with critical processes and transmit it to IT applications, cloud services, and SCADA systems for further processing. Forward-looking manufacturing concepts provide for the connection of previously independent controllers, fieldbus devices, and SCADA systems to each other, as well as to the IT or IoT environment, as investment protection for existing plants/controllers. Numerous standardized protocols are available for data transmission between different communication partners. These include communication interfaces like: MQTT , REST , database, Profibus , Modbus , Simatic Fetch/Write , IEC 60870-5-101 , IEC 60870-5-104 , IEC 61850 , DNP 3.0 , TASE.2 , OPC UA , OPC DA XML, and more. Multiple protocols can be used simultaneously. By default, the usage of one primary and one secondary protocol is licensed. If more protocols shall be used at the same time, an additional license can be purchased. To simplify the configuration further, various templates are available, such as 'Profibus2AzureMQTT' (send data from PROFIBUS DP to the 'Microsoft Azure Cloud' via MQTT protocol). ip4Cloud is available in conjunction with the hardware models SEC3 , SEC3PB and SEC3IO . subpages.title: IPCOMM, ip4Cloud/SEC3IO: Digital IO Module
subpages.desc: Switch, capture, monitor and transmit digital states to cloud, database and SCADA systems. Interfaces for connecting industrial protocols included.
subpages.text: Product Wizard Products Protocols Hardware References Support SCL Explorer RMA Tools Video Tutorials Contact Google Search English Deutsch (DE) English (EN) IPCOMM GmbH Product Wizard Products Protocols Hardware References Support Contact Search Google Search ... Language Deutsch (DE) | English (EN) Support SCL Explorer RMA Tools Video Tutorials ip4Cloud/SEC3IO Characteristics Cyber Security Network Features Configuration Data Processing ip4Cloud/SEC3IO Use Cases Further Information Available Protocol Stacks Hardware ip4Cloud/SEC3IO Switch and monitor digital I/O states to transmit them to IT/Cloud/SCADA services ip4Cloud/SEC3IO extends ip4Cloud by a device with an I/O module to add the feature of switching and capturing digital states and providing them in IT and cloud environments. In addition to a large number of fieldbus protocols, telecontrol protocols, and established IT/cloud protocols, eight digital inputs and eight digital outputs can be used for recording and reflecting switching states. ip4Cloud is available in conjunction with the hardware model SEC3IO . Thanks to numerous interfaces, the device can be easily integrated into individual environments and connected to specialized fieldbus systems. Thus digital data can be controlled and captured from any devices, switches, counters, or sensors, either selectively or periodically. This data can be used for further analysis and processing in IT and cloud applications. Joining of different protocols as well as the simultaneous use of multiple connections is feasible with this module. In addition to the raw value of a data point, the attributes quality and time stamp can also be transferred and processed (protocol-dependent). Language Deutsch (DE) | English (EN) Support SCL Explorer RMA Tools Video Tutorials About Us About Us Established at the beginning of 2004, IPCOMM GmbH is a medium-sized enterprise based at Nuremberg, Germany. Our primary focus is on the development of industrial gateways and inter-network communication solutions. Based on our twenty years development experience in this field and our wide range of products, we are able to offer solutions to almost any communication problem. Over the years we have proven our competence in numerous projects servicing the energy industry, water utilities and gas business around the world, providing turnkey solutions and integrating the solution into existing systems. [Image Brochure] History and Market The development of communication protocols - and gateways - for bridging the information barrier between different protocols is an often underestimated challenge. The complex technology requires tremendous expertise and know-how. The early days of telecontrol technology saw the emergence of a great variety of proprietary protocols due to the lack of appropriate standards. These were continuously expanded and adapted to project specific needs in order to meet customer requirements. Many of these protocols have already disappeared; others have found widespread use and are still popular today as the systems boast a very long life cycle.
